tools.name: foxguard_scan
tools.description: Run a FoxGuard security scan over a path: 200+ SAST rules across 12 languages, secret detection, OSV-backed dependency scanning, and a post-quantum crypto audit. Returns a severity breakdown and each finding (file, line, rule, CWE, description). Requires the `foxguard` CLI on PATH (npx foxguard, pipx install foxguard, or https://foxguard.dev/install.sh).

path.description: File or directory to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

severity.description: Only return findings at or above this severity.
